description: A45 — 非主流也需出子完整

intro.popup_en:
Rapid Development, Practice 10
The principles of rapid development apply regardless of the opening you choose.
intro.popup:
快速出子第10局
无论走什么开局，快速出子的原则都适用

outro.popup_en: Summary: rapid development is a general opening principle that applies to every system.
outro.popup: 总结：快速出子是开局通则，适用于所有体系

moves.popup_en: d4 opens with a queen's pawn and controls the center.
moves.popup:
d4开局
皇后兵，控制中心

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6! Black develops immediately, attacks d4, and controls e4.
moves.popup:
Nf6！黑方立即出动马
进攻d4，控制e4格

moves.popup_en: Bg5! The Trompowsky: White develops the bishop to pin the knight. An unusual opening, but an effective one.
moves.popup:
Bg5！特罗姆普开局！
象到g5，牵制黑马
非主流但有效

moves.popup_en: ...Ne4! Black's knight attacks the bishop and forces it to move, a typical Trompowsky response.
moves.popup:
Ne4！黑马进攻！
逼退白象
特罗姆普的典型应对

moves.popup_en: Bf4 retreats. The bishop has moved twice, from g5 to f4, but this is part of the system rather than aimless repetition.
moves.popup:
Bf4！象撤退到f4
⚠️ 注意：象走了2步（g5→f4）
但这是体系要求，不是随意重复

moves.popup_en: ...d5 advances and contests the center.
moves.popup:
d5推进
黑方争中心

moves.popup_en: e3 supports and stabilizes the d4-pawn.
moves.popup:
e3支撑
稳固d4兵

moves.popup_en: ...c5! Black directly challenges White's center.
moves.popup:
c5！黑方攻击白方中心
主动争夺

moves.popup_en: Bd3! The bishop reaches its ideal square after moving three times (g5-f4-d3). The route is justified because d3 is its intended post.
moves.popup:
Bd3！象到最佳格
象走了3步（g5→f4→d3）
但d3是最终最佳位置，值得！

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops Black's first knight.
moves.popup:
Nc6黑方马出动
黑方第1个大马出动

moves.popup_en: c3 reinforces the center and prevents ...cxd4.
moves.popup:
c3支撑
稳固中心，阻止...cxd4

moves.popup_en: ...Qb6! Black brings the queen out early, attacking d4 and b2.
moves.popup:
Qb6！黑方后出动
⚠️ 黑方后过早出动，威胁d4和b2

moves.popup_en: Qb3! White meets the queen and offers an exchange to remove the threats.
moves.popup:
Qb3！白方后出动
对战对方的后
主动要求兑后，消除威胁

moves.popup_en: ...Qxb3 exchanges queens and simplifies the position.
moves.popup:
Qxb3黑方兑后
双方后兑换，局面简化

moves.popup_en: axb3 recaptures. White's pawn structure is slightly improved, with a semi-open a-file.
moves.popup:
axb3接回
白方棋形略好（半开a线）

moves.popup_en: ...cxd4 challenges White's d4-pawn.
moves.popup:
cxd4兑换
黑方打击d4

moves.popup_en: cxd4 recaptures and maintains White's central presence.
moves.popup:
cxd4接回
白方保持中心

moves.popup_en: ...e6 reinforces Black's position.
moves.popup: e6黑方稳固

moves.popup_en: Nc3! White finally develops the first knight, controlling d5 and e4.
moves.popup:
Nc3！白方马终于出动！
第1个马出动，控制d5和e4

moves.popup_en: ...Bb4 pins the knight.
moves.popup:
Bb4黑方象牵制
牵制白马

moves.popup_en: Nge2! White develops the second knight. Although development was slower than usual, all minor pieces are now out.
moves.popup:
Nge2！第2个马出动
白方双马出动完毕
虽然开局较慢，但出子完整

moves.popup_en: ...Bxc3 exchanges the bishop for a knight.
moves.popup:
Bxc3黑方兑换
消除一匹马

moves.popup_en: Nxc3 recaptures. In the Trompowsky, the bishop's extra moves were required by the system, but the core principle remains: complete development of all minor pieces.
moves.popup:
Nxc3接回
总结：特罗姆普非主流开局
象走多步是体系要求，但核心不变：
最终所有轻子必须完整出动！
快速出子原则适用于所有开局体系
